name: @rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dtgsen
description: Reorders the generalized real Schur decomposition of a real matrix pair (A, B) (in terms of an orthonormal equivalence transformation Qᵀ·(A, B)·Z), so that a selected cluster of eigenvalues appears in the leading diagonal blocks of the upper quasi-triangular matrix A and the upper triangular B
